app_info.subtitle: Search public wiki memory
app_info.description: Kinic Wiki helps users discover public wiki databases, search public knowledge nodes, read task-focused context, and inspect public wiki evidence from ChatGPT.

justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Discover the official public Kinic Wiki database by its stable name.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use only KinicWiki's find_databases tool to find the public Kinic Wiki database named "KINIC-WIKI". Return its exact name, database id, and public link.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the KINIC-WIKI database with its database id and public link.

test_cases.description: Answer a normal question from whole-database task-scoped context.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Kinic Wiki database db_kva4v2twg6jv, use only the context tool once with task-scoped context across the whole database to summarize how the browser clipper stores captured pages. Include the exact supporting wiki paths in the answer.
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the browser clipper workflow from public wiki nodes and identifies the supporting wiki paths.

test_cases.description: Search the fixed public database and read the strongest matching pages.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Kinic Wiki database db_kva4v2twg6jv, call search once for "clipper usage" with prefix / and limit 3. Then call fetch_many once for the first two results. Do not pass ChatGPT citation tokens such as turn0file0. Instead, pass each result's exact public URL, constructing it as https://wiki.kinic.xyz/db/db_kva4v2twg6jv{path} from its metadata path if needed. Use no other tools. Summarize those pages and identify their exact wiki paths.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes the relevant clipper usage guidance from the strongest public wiki pages and identifies those pages.

test_cases.description: List the fixed database root and batch-read two explicit public paths.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Kinic Wiki database db_kva4v2twg6jv, use only list and then read_paths: list the top-level inventory under /, then read /Wiki/operators/browser-and-clipper.md and /Wiki/operators/index.md together. Briefly summarize each page after reading them.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the top-level public inventory and summarizes the two requested operator pages.

test_cases.description: Inspect the fixed database capabilities and read one explicit public path.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use only memory_manifest and then read_path to show the public manifest for Kinic Wiki database db_kva4v2twg6jv, then read and briefly summarize /Wiki/architecture/code-map.md.
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the database's public capabilities and read-only policy, then summarizes the requested code map page.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for write or delete requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete this record and replace it with my edited version.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only supports anonymous read-only public wiki access.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for private database or credential requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use my password and API token to open a private, non-public database.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because private access and credentials are outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal productivity data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow and who should I email afterward?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar and email workflows are outside its scope.
